status: Research experiment; not a protocol parameter approval

evidence_classes.M_ARCHIVE: Reaggregated uploaded historical measurements, not newly collected node/LLM measurements
evidence_classes.R_TRACE: New replay of archived accepted-claim opportunities under a shadow Account Bond; not consensus replay
evidence_classes.S_MODEL: New deterministic capital/arrival experiment with explicit assumptions; not REAL/heartbeat measurement
evidence_classes.D_CONDITIONAL: Derived from identified measurements plus assumed monetary rates and policy candidates

legacy_reservation_source: ADR-0176 2026-10-15 synthetic A16 8k quote, NOT universal claim pricing or a new measurement
legacy_hold_scope: Optimistic budget-window-only fixture, NOT observed release of legacy liability; all other constraints omitted
hold_scope: Exogenous lawful release at H in the fixture only. Neither notice expiry nor hard deadline itself releases collateral. Includes a separate never-release experiment.
targets_scope: Unapproved sensitivity levels, NOT selected after results as acceptance thresholds

pricing.scope: ALL monetary rates, human/operations costs, tariff, margin, bounty, burn and waits are assumptions, not quotes, market prices, or approvals. Measured local CPU/DA bytes are only partial work, not the closed F02/F03 job envelope.

cross_profile_scope: Legacy A16 8k capital quote and Qwen2.5-0.5B verifier timings are NOT a matched profile. No simultaneous same-profile gate is passed.
